response.raw_brief_summary: Six-storey (G+5) residential apartment tower on a 36 ft × 70 ft Pune plot with stilt parking. Each of the five upper floors (and presumed ground floor) contains one 2BHK unit with living-dining, kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and balcony. Lift core and fire staircase serve all floors.
